items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was at least as good as an inventor anytime as Les Paul. He invented the foot pedal guitar, that was his baby, never got credit for it

ctx.x: Do you remember a George Handy chart called, “Stocking Horse?”

Sure do, well George got me in the band, he wasn’t in the band himself but he wrote for it. Yeah, “Stocking Horse,” and a few other things and there were so totally atypical of the band. It was another one of those bands that wasn’t much fun to play in, except Alvino was a wonderful guy. Hell of a Spanish guitar player, and he was an inventor, he was at least as good as an inventor anytime as Les Paul. He invented the foot pedal guitar, that was his baby, never got credit for it and Alvino was one of these guys…
